svg.aria-label: InferaV3 — A quiet knowledge workspace: ask your documents, get answers that cite them. MiniLM embeddings + FAISS search, reranked; Permissions enforced on every retrieval; Local LLM via Ollama, streamed token by token. Built with Django, React + TS, FAISS, Ollama.
